_comment: Run template for nuig-ahu101: a real 100% outdoor-air handler (thermal wheel, frost / cooling / post-heat coils, fixed-step supply fan 0/40/60%) serving one lecture theatre. Hourly resample of the 15-minute store. Only rules that fit that design: supply-air temperature against the BMS's own calculated setpoint (fan-gated), simultaneous heating and cooling on the post-heat and cooling valves, room CO2 against the default occupied schedule, and the fan's night / weekend setback. Left out on purpose: outdoor_air_fraction, economizer_high_limit, leaking_valve and free_cooling_missed need a mixed-air temperature or an economizing damper this unit does not have; dcv_verification needs an outdoor-air flow or damper signal (the OA flow follows the fan speed, which is not an OA measurement); the SAT-reset rules judge a multi-zone VAV reset, not this single-zone cascade. Normal-operation note: simultaneous_heat_cool trips on this unit (both valves > 5% in 13% of fan-on minutes, 78% of them in June-July, with the cooling coil leaving at ~12 C and the post-heat valve at 100%): that is the signature of dehumidification with reheat, which the published data neither confirms nor rules out -- a question for the site, not a verified fault.
